topic: Setting staging factor for transit data
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on setting a specific 'stage' factor (19) for rail and metro inventory, matching the factor used in City data. This factor needs to be applied only to staging environments.

[me] agreed to implement the factor of 19 on `staging-mods` and create a new dataset version containing this factor in MOPS, which would not automatically update but would end upon addition for the day.
[p1] clarified that the factor should initially be applied only within MOPS.
decisions: The staging factor of 19 will be set for rail and metro inventory on staging environments.
The factor implementation must initially be restricted to MOPS.
action_items: [me] to implement the stage factor of 19 on `staging-mods` and create a new, non-auto-updating dataset version in MOPS.
